report:
Weekly Mobile-Store Feedback Pulse (Week of Sep 22-28, 2026)

Top Themes:
1. Monetization/Ads – 45% of low-rating reviews cite forced premium upsell and frequent ads.
2. Technical Stability – 30% report stuttering, false offline status, playback cuts, and search glitches.
3. Recommendation & Library – 18% complain about repeat songs, limited skips, hidden podcasts and lost liked tracks.

Key User Quotes:
- "isme premium lene ke liye force kar raha hai aagar na le to mere pasand ka gana sunne nahi de raha hai bakwas app hai download mat karo"
- "app has really deteriorated over time. It's constantly stuttering like a scratched CD when playing music, and the search feature is constantly glitching."
- "The same problem always. I cannot play a full song. It always plays for a little time. Like a trial song."

Action Items:
1. Redesign ad flow: cap ad frequency, add a 7-day ad-free trial to entice upgrades.
2. Launch a stability sprint: fix offline detection, audio buffering, and search bugs across iOS/Android.
3. Refine recommendation engine: introduce flexible skip limits, a hide-podcast option, and preserve music queue when switching to podcasts.

Overall Sentiment: Users love Spotify's catalog and UI, but ad pressure, bugs, and repetitive content risk churn.
